meta.description: ORVIBO smart downlights and spotlights: an all-in-one, plug-and-play design that needs no dimming module, control from the app or smart switches, and links with MixPad S for whole-home smart lighting.
meta.spec.description: Smart downlight DD10Z and smart spotlight DS10Z specifications: size and cutout, power, input, color temperature, dimming, optics and Zigbee.
sec1.desc: The first choice for homes over 100 m²
sec1.title: Smart Tunable Light
sec2.title: Every beam of light holds a mood and a moment
sec2.desc:
Light that understands life: the right lighting for every time and place, following your mood so every happy moment is well lit.
Mix lighting setups to suit what you do, with its own comfortable light for reading, films or games.
sec3.title: Stepless brightness and color temperature, endless fun
sec10.title: Smart lighting for better sleep for the whole family
sec10.desc:
ORVIBO smart lighting helps the whole family sleep better.
Whether you need energy for an early start or focus for work and study, it gives you the most comfortable light.
sec11.title: With the MixPad S panel, smart lighting all over the home
sec11.desc:
Connect smart lights to MixPad S for five ways of control that work together:
AI voice, the app, switches, panels and sensors. Scenes are a tap away, so smart light stays simple.
sec4.title: Free grouping and custom scenes, one tap in the app
sec4.desc:
Control each light on its own, or group several downlights or spotlights
and switch them all with one tap, for whole-home lighting that works together beautifully.
sec5.title: All-in-one design, as easy to fit as a traditional light
sec5.desc:
A clean, simple all-in-one build with standard fittings and a recessed design that suits most ceilings.
It runs straight off mains power, is easy to install and use, and blends into your home as simply as a traditional light.
sec6.title: Zigbee connects the whole home
sec6.desc:
Industrial-grade Zigbee: reliable, expandable, with routing built in for many lights.
More stable than Wi-Fi, with a longer range than Bluetooth.
sec7.title: Ra90 for true-to-life colors
sec7.desc: Ra90 color rendering and up to 350 lm/450 lm of light output make everything look truer, in your home's real colors.
sec8.title: Quality LEDs: no flicker, no glare, low energy
sec8.desc:
A quality IC driver and LED source dim without flicker; the anti-glare design eases eye strain.
The wide, even light source is also energy-efficient.
sec9.title: Installation
sec9.desc: * Turn off the power before installing.
spec.downlight.name: Smart Downlight
spec.downlight.size: Size: 2.5 in, Ø91 × 63 mm, 70–80 mm cutout
spec.spotlight.name: Smart Spotlight
spec.spotlight.size: Size: 2.5 in, Ø85 × 60 mm, 70–80 mm cutout
spec.spotlight.optics: Optics: COB + lens, 32° beam angle, 30° tilt
m.zigbee.title: Zigbee across your smart home
m.zigbee.desc: An industrial-grade Zigbee protocol, reliable and easy to extend. Built-in routing suits homes with many lights: more stable than Wi‑Fi, with more range than Bluetooth.

Cut: use a hole saw to cut a
70–80 mm hole in the ceiling.

Wire: connect the wires to the

Fit: bend the spring clips up
and push the light into the hole.
pic.power_release_the_clips:
Power: release the clips to
hold it, then turn on the power.
